text.p: Close of play scores on the second day of four-day English County Championship cricket matches on Thursday:
At Liverpool: Glamorgan 173-1 (S.James 99 not out) v Lancashire.
At Bristol: Middlesex 237 all out and 78-6 (J.Lewis 4-34). Gloucestershire 99 all out (R.Johnson 4-27).
At Derby: Sussex 200-9 declared. Derbyshire 209-8 (C.Adams 53; V.Drakes 4-44).
At Worcester: Surrey 452-9 declared (J.Ratcliffe 135, A.Brown 121; S.Lampitt 4-104). Worcestershire 81-1.
At Bath: Leicestershire 442-6 (J.Whitaker 133 not out, I.Sutcliffe 112, V.Wells 70, D.Maddy 58) v Somerset.
At Trent Bridge: Yorkshire 364 all out (D.Byas 128, D.Lehmann 62, M.Moxon 60; K.Evans 6-91). Nottinghamshire 116-4.
At Darlington: Durham 215-7 (J.Lewis 158 not out; M.Fleming 5-55). Kent 138-4.
At Northampton: Hampshire 373-6 (M.Hayden 150, R.Smith 74, D.James 56; P.Taylor 4-81) v Northamptonshire.
